mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.warning_id, t.dept_id, t.source_dept_id, t.fire_point_id, t.handler_role_id, t.handler_role_key, t.handler_role_name, t.assignee_user_id, t.assignee_user_name, t.assignee_nick_name, t.task_status, t.dispatch_source, t.dispatch_time, t.dispatch_by, t.first_view_time, t.start_time, t.reassign_count, t.last_reassign_time, t.last_reassign_by, t.reassign_reason, t.end_time, t.end_reason, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.del_flag, d.dept_name, sd.dept_name as source_dept_name, fp.fire_point_name, w.warning_type, w.alarm_state, w.warning_status, w.trigger_time, w.last_trigger_time, w.threshold_snapshot, w.evidence_summary, w.recovery_time, w.recovery_source, w.recovery_evidence, s.sensor_code, g.imei as gateway_imei, e.label_code as extinguisher_label_code from fe_device_warning_task t inner join fe_device_warning w on t.warning_id = w.warning_id left join sys_dept d on t.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept sd on t.source_dept_id = sd.dept_id left join fe_fire_point fp on t.fire_point_id = fp.fire_point_id left join fe_sensor s on w.sensor_id = s.sensor_id left join fe_gateway g on w.gateway_id = g.gateway_id left join fe_extinguisher e on w.extinguisher_id = e.extinguisher_id
mapper.select: where t.task_id = #{taskId} and t.del_flag = '0' and w.del_flag = '0' limit 1
where t.warning_id = #{warningId} and t.del_flag = '0' and w.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select w.* from fe_device_warning w where w.del_flag = '0' and w.alarm_state = 'active' and w.source_dept_id = #{sourceDeptId} and not exists ( select 1 from fe_device_warning_task t where t.warning_id = w.warning_id and t.del_flag = '0' ) order by w.warning_id

select role_id as roleId, role_name as roleName, role_key as roleKey, role_sort as roleSort, data_scope as dataScope, status from sys_role where role_key = #{roleKey} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select u.user_id as userId, u.dept_id as deptId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.status, last_dispatch.last_dispatch_time as loginDate from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join ( select assignee_user_id, max(dispatch_time) as last_dispatch_time from fe_device_warning_task where del_flag = '0' and assignee_user_id is not null group by assignee_user_id ) last_dispatch on u.user_id = last_dispatch.assignee_user_id where u.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.role_key = #{roleKey} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' order by case when last_dispatch.last_dispatch_time is null then 0 else 1 end, last_dispatch.last_dispatch_time, u.user_id

select distinct u.user_id as userId, u.dept_id as deptId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.status, last_dispatch.last_dispatch_time as loginDate from sys_user u inner join sys_dept ud on u.dept_id = ud.dept_id inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join ( select assignee_user_id, max(dispatch_time) as last_dispatch_time from fe_device_warning_task where del_flag = '0' and assignee_user_id is not null group by assignee_user_id ) last_dispatch on u.user_id = last_dispatch.assignee_user_id where ( (#{sourceDeptId} is not null and (u.dept_id = #{sourceDeptId} or find_in_set(#{sourceDeptId}, ud.ancestors))) or (#{sourceDeptId} is null and u.dept_id = #{deptId}) ) and r.role_key in (#{handlerRoleKey}, #{coordinatorRoleKey}) and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' group by u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.status, last_dispatch.last_dispatch_time order by case when u.dept_id = #{deptId} then 0 else 1 end, min(case when r.role_key = #{handlerRoleKey} then 0 else 1 end), case when last_dispatch.last_dispatch_time is null then 0 else 1 end, last_dispatch.last_dispatch_time, u.user_id

select distinct u.user_id as userId, u.dept_id as deptId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.status from sys_user u inner join sys_dept ud on u.dept_id = ud.dept_id inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and ( (#{sourceDeptId} is not null and (u.dept_id = #{sourceDeptId} or find_in_set(#{sourceDeptId}, ud.ancestors))) or (#{sourceDeptId} is null and u.dept_id = #{deptId}) ) and r.role_key in (#{handlerRoleKey}, #{coordinatorRoleKey}) and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select r.role_id as roleId, r.role_name as roleName, r.role_key as roleKey, r.role_sort as roleSort, r.data_scope as dataScope, r.status from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.role_key in (#{handlerRoleKey}, #{coordinatorRoleKey}) and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' order by case when r.role_key = #{handlerRoleKey} then 0 else 1 end limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fe_device_warning_task ( warning_id, dept_id, source_dept_id, fire_point_id, handler_role_id, handler_role_key, handler_role_name, assignee_user_id, assignee_user_name, assignee_nick_name, task_status, dispatch_source, dispatch_time, dispatch_by, first_view_time, start_time, reassign_count, last_reassign_time, last_reassign_by, reassign_reason, end_time, end_reason, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag ) values ( #{warningId}, #{deptId}, #{sourceDeptId}, #{firePointId}, #{handlerRoleId}, #{handlerRoleKey}, #{handlerRoleName}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{assigneeUserName}, #{assigneeNickName}, #{taskStatus}, #{dispatchSource}, #{dispatchTime}, #{dispatchBy}, #{firstViewTime}, #{startTime}, #{reassignCount}, #{lastReassignTime}, #{lastReassignBy}, #{reassignReason}, #{endTime}, #{endReason}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, '0' )
mapper.update: update fe_device_warning_task set handler_role_id = #{handlerRoleId}, handler_role_key = #{handlerRoleKey}, handler_role_name = #{handlerRoleName}, assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, assignee_user_name = #{assigneeUserName}, assignee_nick_name = #{assigneeNickName}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, dispatch_source = #{dispatchSource}, dispatch_time = #{dispatchTime}, dispatch_by = #{dispatchBy}, first_view_time = null, reassign_count = #{reassignCount}, last_reassign_time = #{lastReassignTime}, last_reassign_by = #{lastReassignBy}, reassign_reason = #{reassignReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' and task_status in ('manual_pending', 'assigned')

update fe_device_warning_task set task_status = #{taskStatus}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, end_reason = #{endReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' and task_status = 'assigned'

update fe_device_warning_task set task_status = #{taskStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' and task_status in ('processing', 'waiting_external', 'verifying')
mapper.select: select record_id, task_id, warning_id, action_type, action_channel, action_description, next_task_status, operator_user_id, operator_user_name, operator_nick_name, action_time, create_by, create_time from fe_device_warning_task_record where task_id = #{taskId} order by action_time desc, record_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into fe_device_warning_task_attachment ( task_id, warning_id, record_id, original_name, stored_path, file_type, file_size, uploader_user_id, uploader_user_name, uploader_nick_name, upload_time, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) values ( #{taskId}, #{warningId}, #{recordId}, #{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{uploaderUserId}, #{uploaderUserName}, #{uploaderNickName}, #{uploadTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, '0' )
mapper.select: select attachment_id, task_id, warning_id, record_id, original_name, stored_path, file_type, file_size, uploader_user_id, uploader_user_name, uploader_nick_name, upload_time, create_by, create_time, del_flag from fe_device_warning_task_attachment where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' order by upload_time, attachment_id

select attachment_id, task_id, warning_id, record_id, original_name, stored_path, file_type, file_size, uploader_user_id, uploader_user_name, uploader_nick_name, upload_time, create_by, create_time, del_flag from fe_device_warning_task_attachment where attachment_id = #{attachmentId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.update: update fe_device_warning_task set first_view_time = #{viewTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where task_id = #{taskId} and first_view_time is null and del_flag = '0'

update fe_device_warning_task t inner join fe_device_warning w on t.warning_id = w.warning_id set t.task_status = 'recovered', t.end_time = #{endTime}, t.end_reason = #{endReason}, t.update_by = #{updateBy}, t.update_time = #{updateTime} where t.del_flag = '0' and w.del_flag = '0' and w.alarm_state = 'recovered' and w.source_dept_id = #{sourceDeptId} and t.task_status in ('manual_pending', 'assigned', 'processing', 'waiting_external', 'verifying')
